comparison.interpretation: Lakera L2 is the hardest PI stress test for content detectors (crowdsourced, contextual). A3S ~50% TPR here is typically PI-channel misses + RBAC hits on the follow-on dangerous tool — i.e. the system boundary still holds when detectors fail. InjecAgent enhanced often embeds classic injection phrases, so both PI + deny-by-default attacker tools score high. Hendar is a small academy/CI set: useful regression signal, not a conference SOTA bar.
